name: Bixiga 70
description: São Paulo's Bixiga 70 brings Brazilian psychedelic Afrobeat to Gretchen, a collision of Fela Kuti's polyrhythms with the groove of 1970s Brazil. The ten-piece ensemble channels the spirit of São Paulo's working-class Bixiga neighborhood, where African diaspora culture meets Italian immigration and samba meets candomblé. Their instrumental sound is politically charged without words, a sonic resistance rooted in the favelas and the dancefloor. Expect a sweaty, ecstatic celebration of global Black music.
